name: bwinkeler-lists
description: Collaborative shared-lists application (service_id: lists) for the bwinkeler.com platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bwinkeler-lists/shared && npm run build -w @bwinkeler-lists/backend && npm run build -w @bwinkeler-lists/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bwinkeler-lists/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
